snippet.title: Discounty Launch Trailer - Future Games Show gamescom 2025
snippet.description:
Discounty is an adorable life simulator where you manage a small-town supermarket and get caught up in all the quotidian drama. Expand your aunt's business empire when it launches across PC and consoles on August 21.
